item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: make this pic talk in a video

dialog.agent:
I can make this into a talking video. I just need to know what she should say:

1. **The words:** Type out what she should say. I'll turn it into speech with an AI voice and then animate the photo to match.
2. **Or your own recording:** Attach an audio file (MP3, WAV or M4A) and I'll make her mouth move to it.

If you give me text, you can also tell me what kind of voice you want, like warm, upbeat or calm. If you don't, I'll pick a natural-sounding one. Your account will be charged credits for the speech and the video.

Please only use this with your own photo or one you have permission to use.
dialog.why: The assistant asks the user what she should say (text or an audio file) and waits for that input before making anything.
dialog.user: say "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new." friendly girl voice, not mine. it's me in the pic btw

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the video yet because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. My first step was generating the voice clip, which costs about 8 credits, and the account refused it. That means it also can't cover the video step, which costs more. Nothing was created, so no credits were used.

**To get this working:**
- **Add credits:** Your free plan may refill credits over time, or you can buy a credit pack on magichour.ai. Then tell me "go" and I'll make it with the same voice ("Bright Creator," a friendly woman's voice) and your line.
- **Record the line yourself:** This skips the voice step, but the video step still needs credits. Since you wanted a voice that isn't yours, a friend's recording would work too.
